title: Return a local count
prompt: Repair remainingAfter. It must return opening plus arrivals minus completed. Inputs are nonnegative counts and completions never exceed all available tasks. The starter tries to return a name outside its block.
hints: Read the name mentioned in the diagnostic.
Find the pair of braces that contains the declaration of that name.
Return a value from a place where all of its inputs are in scope.
feedback: Read the name mentioned in the diagnostic.
